items.title: HIV charities lament NICE snub for Gilead’s twice-yearly lenacapavir
items.summary: Though yet to be finalised, the initial recommendation would mean the injectable PrEP would not be covered on the NHS.

items.title: ERS 2026: BMI, type-2 inflammation, and asthma attack risk
items.summary: At ERS 2026, investigators reported their findings from their review of the Oxford Asthma Attack Risk Scale Meta-Analysis (ORACLE2).

items.title: Staunch biotech competition spurs new secretive tactics, shifts investor approach
items.summary: Biotechs and investors are increasingly altering their strategies amid changes in the development and commercial landscape.

items.title: Exegenesis Bio and Modalis sign research deal for Duchenne therapy
items.summary: Exegenesis Bio and Modalis Therapeutics have entered into a research partnership and licence agreement to progress MDL-201, a therapeutic candidate for DMD.

items.title: ABEC to expand global manufacturing network with new Wilson facility
items.summary: ABEC is to open a new manufacturing facility in Wilson, North Carolina, US, expanding its network for biopharmaceutical process equipment.
